speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what are the criteria to assess the need for traffic speed regulating measures in a housing estate; and (b) how often are these measures reviewed to assess their adequacy after the measures are installed.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: To further enhance the safety of vulnerable roads users, such as school children and elderly pedestrians, LTA would also implement special schemes.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: School Zone features include speed regulating strips and red-textured road surfaces to alert drivers to slow down.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Silver Zone features include pinch-points to narrow, and chicanes to curve the road, to get motorists to slow down.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Such infrastructural speed regulating measures are complemented by the Traffic Police's speed enforcement cameras and regular enforcement operations.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Can I request LTA to work with the Traffic Police to take enforcement action against speeding vehicles with very noisy exhaust engines and they rev their engines when they speed?

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: I happen to be quite familiar with Alexandra Road; my office is along that stretch.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: My experience so far has been relatively pleasant.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: I do not encounter speeding and noisy exhaust, as related by the Member.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: But I, too, dislike motorists with noisy exhausts.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: If, indeed, there are many such incidents, we will try to fix it.
